## 2. Learning metrics

No learners yet (local only, nothing deployed), so recall, completion and dwell have **no data**. The only learning-adjacent signal is the simulated-learner launch rate, and that is a judgement, not a measurement.

| Metric | This week | Last week | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revisit recall rate | no data | no data | needs deploy + real learners (EXP-002) |
| Prediction → reveal completion | no data | no data | |
| QA failures (dead control / console error) | 0 of 426 integrated; 80 lessons await a QA record | 0 of 186 | |
| Simulated-learner launch rate | 30 of 89 reviewed (34%) | 5 of 44 (11%) | Rose for lessons built after the earn-the-reveal rules (probability 13/20, chemistry 14/30), versus about 5/44 for the earlier physics and math |

- cs, ai, economics, life, geography: no learner reviews yet. Life is in progress; the others are queued.

## 5. Decisions needed from the founder
1. Ratify AMD-001 (a–d), especially (d): the gate must read the verdict and the version.
2. Human source checks: UN WPP 2024 (half-of-humanity c1, blocked from the session) and the Bullard 1965 table.
3. A usage budget. At about 21k build + 5k check + about 8k review tokens per lesson, 200 more lessons cost about 7M tokens.
4. When to deploy to Vercel so the learning metrics start (runbook-deploy.md is ready; it needs your account).
